name: CRM App (Flutter + Dart)
postCreateCommand: cd frontend && flutter pub get && flutter build web --release --web-renderer html && cd ../backend && dart pub get
postStartCommand: cd backend && (nohup dart run bin/server.dart > /tmp/crm-backend.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 1 && echo 'Backend running — open the forwarded 8080 port to use the app.'
